messages:
mara.c: quick heads-up: saw a bunch of owner flips ~12:05 today, looks like rotation splay too small during surge. opening thread to sync before patch.

samir: can you share example ids? hubspot webhook retries or enrichment delays?

mara.c: small sample: 12:04:52 lead-123 -> ownerA, 12:04:59 lead-123 -> ownerB, 12:05:12 lead-123 -> ownerC; enrichment returned at 12:05:50.

jess: that matches a 5s splay + 8s claim timeout race. if multiple assign events land they stomp.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: claim-service v1.8 0.3% 500s last 15m; enrichment-api v2.1 healthy.

alex.g: proposed quick fix: increase splay_window to 30s, add claim lease 15s, add jitter. low risk config change.

mara.c: draft config: splay_window: 30
splay_jitter_pct: 0.25
claim_lease_secs: 15
retry_backoff_ms: 500

samir: two asks: 1) migration for in-flight? 2) VIP lead SLA impact?

jess: no migration needed; lease applies on next attempt. for VIPs we should skip splay (immediate assign). recommend gating on lead.tags includes "vip" or "demo-schedule".

mara.c: will add gating rule: if vip -> splay_window=0 else use config.

alex.g: also flag leads that reassign >2 times in 60s to route to overflow pool and fire a support ticket.

ops-bot: incident-signal: alert rule created -> #support when reassign_count > 2 within 60s.

samir: plan: mara -> push config to staging, run 30m smoke with synthetic bursts, then 10% canary tomorrow 10:00am PT. jess writes VIP testcases, alex wires overflow alert.

mara.c: opening PR now, will add rollout notes and test checklist. ETA EOD.

jess: will review PR and add hubspot webhook dedupe check, but config should mitigate most flips. :thumbsup:

mara.c: thanks all, will follow up in the PR comments with results.
